message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned by discarding all cards in your hand before opponents. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card, draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, keep it.
2. **Play** – Place a card from your hand onto the discard pile if it matches the color, number, or symbol of the top card, or if it’s a Wild card.
3. **Discard** – If you have no playable cards after drawing, you must pass. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (in 2‑player games, acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, they score points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add round scores to each player’s cumulative total. First to reach the target (e.g., 500) wins the game. | | **Special Variations** | • **Stacking** – Some house rules allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards.
• **Seven‑Eight** – If you play a 7, you can swap hands with another player; if you play an 8, you can skip the next player.
• **Custom Rules** – Many players add house rules (e.g., “Uno” shout requirement, penalty for forgetting to say “Uno”). | **Key Tips** 1. **Keep track of the top card’s color and number** – this helps you decide whether to play or draw. 2. **Use Wild cards strategically** – change the color when you’re stuck or when you want to force opponents into a difficult position. 3. **Watch opponents’ hands** – if you see someone with only one card, try to play a Skip or Draw Two to prevent them from winning. 4. **Remember “Uno”** – when you have one card left, you must say “Uno” before your opponent takes their turn; otherwise, you’ll have to draw two cards as a penalty. That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak or add house rules to suit your group.
